description:
**Blocked by d06.2 (UI.State + hooks must exist). Read the deck §6
"Layout & composition", §9 "OSC welding without special cases",
and §13 "Worked example: streaming Markdown" before starting.**

This ticket migrates the Transcript module itself plus its two
marker entries (AssistantHeader, AssistantStatus) plus the OSC 133
welder. It does **not** convert the content entries (BashExecution,
ToolExecution, AssistantMessage blocks, etc.) — those live in
d06.5, d06.9, d06.10 and can be done in any order via the Compat
adapter from d06.1.

**Read first (existing implementation):**
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/transcript.ex` — the slot
  store. Pay attention to: `render/2` walks slots oldest-first and
  calls `mod.render(entry, ctx)`; `update/3` and `finalize/3`
  raise if the entry's module doesn't implement
  StreamingComponent; `next_deadline/1` aggregates `wake_at` per
  slot. The slot model already mirrors the VHole model; this
  ticket replaces the per-slot render call with a VHole emission.
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/transcript/assistant_header.ex`
  and `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/transcript/assistant_status.ex`
  — the two marker entries. Today they implement Component;
  under VDom they become VHoles whose render functions emit
  empty VFlows or an error VText (unchanged behaviour, new shape).
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex` lines
  2407-2463 — `render_transcript/4`, `weld_assistant_turns/1`,
  `do_weld/3`, `weld_lines/3`. The full OSC-welder logic that
  this ticket replaces with a VZone.
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/transcript_test.exs` — the
  acceptance bar. Every assertion stays green.

**Target shape:**
- `Transcript` exposes `to_vnode(transcript, ctx) :: vnode` that
  returns a `%VFlow{}` of (a) plain VHoles for non-assistant-turn
  slots, (b) `%VZone{open, close, final, child: %VFlow{children:
  vholes}}` wrapping every assistant-turn span (delimited today by
  AssistantHeader → AssistantStatus pairs).
- The Transcript struct's existing `cache`, `dirty`, `wake_at`
  fields go away — caching is now framework-level via VMemo on
  each VHole; deadlines via `use_frame` inside streaming
  components. The struct keeps `order` and `data`.
- AssistantHeader and AssistantStatus convert to functional
  components that take `props = %{msg_id, has_tool_calls?}` /
  `props = %{stop_reason, error_message, has_tool_calls?}` and
  return `%VFlow{children: []}` when they have nothing to render
  (matching today's behaviour where they emit `[]` lines).

**OSC welding via VZone (deck §9):**
- Constants: open `"\\e]133;A\\a"`, close `"\\e]133;B\\a"`, final
  `"\\e]133;C\\a"`.
- The painter's VZone case (from d06.1) prepends `open` to the
  start line of the zone's painted range and appends `close +
  final` to the end line. Empty zone (no painted lines): emit all
  three on a single line.
- "Skip welding when has_tool_calls?" branch: render-time choice
  — emit a plain `%VFlow{}` instead of `%VZone{}`. No post-pass
  walker.

**Acceptance:**
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/transcript_test.exs` stays
  100% green.
- Pixel-diff test: byte-for-byte equality between the legacy
  welder output and the VZone painter output for representative
  fixtures (a turn with text only, a turn with tool calls, an
  empty turn, a turn that's still streaming). Land these fixtures
  as test cases.
- The post-pass functions in interactive.ex
  (`weld_assistant_turns/1`, `do_weld/3`, `weld_lines/3`) are
  deleted in this ticket. Their tests move to the new VZone tests.
- No regression in tmux smoke run (open the TUI, run a prompt,
  confirm OSC 133 zones land correctly in the iTerm2 status bar
  — easiest visual check is "command-click on a turn boundary").

comments.text: Superseded by the tui2 architecture decision in docs/tui-architecture.md. The d06 plan refactored octo_pi_tui in place; the new direction builds octo_pi_tui2 as a parallel implementation on Filament, leaving octo_pi_tui frozen. New epics: opi-58c, opi-pyl, opi-yhj, opi-t3t, opi-ow9, opi-4tr, opi-m6b. Closing without further work.

title: Migrate Transcript dispatcher: VHole-based entry rendering + VZone OSC welder replacement
